messages:
michelle: New hire report: installed redwoodctl from our .deb and `redwoodctl localtest --profile=playground` picked up /etc/xdg profile instead of the user's.

ravi: can you paste `REDWOOD_LOG=debug redwoodctl config resolved`?

michelle: trace: 
[resolver] candidate: /etc/xdg/redwood/profile -> found but unreadable (errno=EACCES)
[resolver] candidate: /home/nh/.config/redwood/profile -> found name: playground
[resolver] requested_profile: playground
[resolver] selected: /etc/xdg/redwood/profile (fallback)

michelle: interestingly the file exists in /etc/xdg but the postinst created it with mode 0600 and root:root; the binary running as the user can't open it due to umask+install step. CLI then falls back and chooses the system one (which was readable to the runtime container), so it ends up using system demo values.

sam: two issues here: packaging shipped a readable system profile plus the postinst set overly-restrictive perms, and the resolver logic silently prefers that file even when it's unreadable by the current user.

ops-packaging: Packaging note: our postinst used `install -m 600` when dropping examples. That's wrong; examples should be 0644 and not owned in a way that blocks runtime reads. Filed PKG-451 to change install mode and to move examples into /usr/share/redwood/examples.

ravi: CLI change: resolver should (1) try opening each candidate and log WARN if unreadable, not silently prefer it; (2) when --profile is provided, search all readable candidates for an exact name match before applying path-order precedence; (3) if requested_profile found but unreadable in some locations, surface a clear error explaining which paths were unreadable and how to fix.

michelle: workaround for onboarding: `sudo chmod 644 /etc/xdg/redwood/profile` then rerun login. New hire was able to login after that.

sam: add unit tests: candidate exists but open fails -> resolver logs and continues; requested_profile present -> prefer exact-match among readable candidates. Also add an integration test for postinst permutation where file is created with 0600 and we confirm we surface a helpful error.

ci-bot: Created tickets: DEVEX-1510 (resolver unreadable-candidate handling) and PKG-451 (postinst file mode + move examples). PR #1623 queued with tests and docs.

ops-packaging: we'll stop symlinking user paths from postinst (that was causing other edge cases) and ensure example files are world-readable and have no real client_id values.

michelle: thanks 12 new hire unblocked. Leaving a short note in the onboarding checklist: "If localtest reads wrong profile after apt install, check /etc/xdg/redwood/profile perms and content."

sam: thanks, will land the resolver fixes and coordinate packaging changes. :thumbsup:
